fields.name: El Tel
fields.description: Rotund, scarred man in partially charred vestments, oddly untroubled by his burns
fields.unique_thing: I am the Dwarf King's most trusted bouncer, the only one trusted to leave his post and check on surface matters, such as the Diabolist's demons.
fields.magic_items:
2 adventurer healing potion (Recovery + 1d8, hp cap 30)

# Armor of Bloody Vengeance: +1 AC - Bloody Vengeance

spells.name: Chant of Endings
spells.desc:
Target: The nearby enemy with the fewest hit points (you choose if there’s a tie; you also don’t have to be able to see that enemy)
Attack: Intelligence + Level vs. MD (+5)
Hit: 1d10 + Intelligence necro damage.

spells.name: Command Undead
spells.desc:
Target: One nearby undead creature with 64 hp or fewer
Attack: Intelligence + Level vs. MD
Hit: The target is confused (hard save ends, 16+).
ADV FEAT: Miss does not expend spell

spells.name: Unholy Blast
spells.desc:
Target: One nearby enemy
Attack: Intelligence + Level vs. PD
Hit: 4d6 + Intelligence negative energy damage.
First Miss: Half damage, and make the attack again against an
enemy you haven’t already targeted with unholy blast this turn.
Second Miss: Half damage, or full damage if the escalation die is
1+ and you choose to decrease it by 1.

spells.name: Summon Undead
spells.desc:
Effect: You summon a mob of 1d3 + 1 crumbling skeleton mooks, as per the summoning rules on page 11. These skeletons fight for you until the end of the battle or until they drop to 0 hp, whichever comes first.

1st level mook [undead]
Initiative: +6 Vulnerability: holy
Sword +6 vs. AC—3 damage+CHA (First attack extra +CHA (3) vs AC)
Resist weapons 16+: When a weapon attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.
AC 16, PD 14, MD 10, HP 6 (mook)
Mook: Kill one crumbling skeleton mook for every 6 damage you deal to the mob.

spells.name: Terror
spells.desc:
One nearby enemy <= 50hp
Attack: Intelligence + Level vs. MD
Hit: The target uses all its actions during its turn to move away from the battle, disengaging from enemies to do so (hard save ends, 16+). If it fails to disengage with all of its actions, it won’t take opportunity attacks by moving. The effect also ends when you or one of your allies attacks the target.
Miss: 1d10 + Intelligence psychic damage

features.name: Grim Determination (built in)
features.desc: When you have one or more Skulls, you gain a +1 bonus to all your defenses. When you have two or more Skulls, it's +2.

features.name: Legendary Prowess (built in)
features.desc: Whenever you fail a Strength or Constitution skill check, you can reroll the skill check once and abide by the reroll.

features.name: Rage (built in)
features.desc:
You can rage. See rage tracker above.

Adventurer Feat: While raging, you gain a +4 bonus to both your PD and your MD

talents.name: Building Frenzy
talents.desc:
The first time you miss with a melee attack each turn, you deal a cumulative +2 damage with your subsequent melee attack hits until the end of the battle, up to a maximum of +12.
2nd +3 per miss, +18 max
4th +4 per miss, +24 max
6th +6 per miss, +36 max
8th +10 per miss, +60 max
10th +15 per miss, +90 max

Adventurer Feat: Count the first time you are staggered each battle as a miss that builds your frenzy.

talents.name: Strongheart
talents.desc: Once per battle, as a free action, when an enemy hits you with an attack against Physical Defense or Mental Defense, you can make the enemy reroll the attack. The rerolled attack automatically misses if it is a natural odd roll.

talents.name: Unstoppable
talents.desc: Once per battle, declare you’re using Unstoppable before making a melee attack. If your attack hits the first target, you can heal using a recovery.

talents.name: Bloody Vengeance (Magic item)
talents.desc:
When a foe hits you and you end up staggered but conscious, you can take a Skull to heal using a recovery as a free action. In addition, until the end of the battle, each of your melee hits against that foe deal +5 damage (champion hero: +10; epic hero: +20).
Quiddity: The item loves to tell stories about previous owners who died heroically or gruesomely or both.

(arc / desperate = 1/arc power but also recharges 1/arc if you fail a death save or spend last recovery)
